title: Composition compatible with total-derived normalized comparisons
statement: Fix a prime ell, a finite extension E of Q_ell, and a field k of positive characteristic different from ell. For the integral compactification composites of [def-sfb-integral-compact-support-interface], given preservation and any comparison family satisfying the three conditions of [lem-sfb-total-derived-normalized-comparisons], there exist composition isomorphisms compatible with simultaneous changes of all three compactifications, as in [lem-sfb-nonrational-localizing-lower-shriek-composition].

source.place: Final paragraph, comparison, composition and base-change normalization.

proof.text: Standing schemes are qcqs because their separated finite-type structure morphisms have qcqs target Spec k. Specialize localizingClosure_ctf_equals_bc to the valuation ring O_E using its identity coefficient isomorphism, obtaining Loc(Dctf) = Loc(Dbc) for the three standing schemes. Transport the preservation hypothesis h across these equalities. The underlying morphisms f and g are separated and finite type by cancellation of their structure maps and quasi-compactness of their sources.

Apply exists_nonrationalLocalizingLowerShriekCompositionSeed with the transported preservation witnesses. Its three boundary compactifications underlie quasi-compact compactifications in the integral interface. Precompose its components with the full inclusion Loc(Dbc) -> Loc(Dctf), defined by the equality above, and apply the target full inclusion to its component isomorphisms. The resulting natural isomorphism is a seed between the actual ambient compactification functors on Loc(Dbc). Naturality is the underlying ambient equality of the seed naturality equation.

For fixed f and g, lift the f-comparison family through the full localizing inclusion using h. Keep the g and gf comparisons with ambient codomain. Define the composition for any compactification triple by comparing its f and g compactifications to the seed, applying the seed, and comparing the seed composite to its requested compactification. For simultaneous changes, naturality moves the f-comparison past the g-comparison. The cocycle equations for f, g and gf collapse the three pairs of comparison factors, proving the displayed compatibility equality. Choose these families for all composable morphisms. This construction needs neither identity nor refinement normalization, and admits identity morphisms and empty schemes.

proof_origin.place: The composition isomorphism; Canonicity and associativity. Seed transport by the supplied cocycle; calculation adapted from the proved private transportComposition helper in Sheaf.Paper.NonrationalLocalizingLowerShriekComposition.

theorem compatibleComposition
    (ℓ : ℕ) [Fact ℓ.Prime]
    (E : PadicAlgCl.FiniteIntermediateField ℓ) [Fact (ringChar k).Prime] [Fact (ringChar k ≠ ℓ)]
    (h : Preservation (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) k) (φ : Comparisons
      (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) k)
    (hi : ∀ {X Y : Spaces k} (f : X ⟶ Y) (c : Compactifications k f),
    φ f c c = Iso.refl _)
    (hc : ∀ {X Y : Spaces k} (f : X ⟶ Y) (c d e : Compactifications k f),
    φ f c d ≪≫ φ f d e = φ f c e)
    (hn : ∀ {X Y : Spaces k} (f : X ⟶ Y) (c d : Compactifications k f)
    (r : c.obj.Refinement d.obj)
    (_boundary : r.hom ⁻¹ᵁ d.obj.i.opensRange = c.obj.i.opensRange)
    (K : (localizing (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) X.obj.left).FullSubcategory),
      ∃ e : (extend (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) d.obj.i).obj K.obj ≅
          (push (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) r.hom).obj ((extend
            (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) c.obj.i).obj K.obj),
        (openAdjunction (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) d.obj.i).homEquiv _ _ e.hom ≫
            refinementRestriction (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) r K.obj =
              (openAdjunction (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) c.obj.i).unit.app K.obj ∧
          (φ f c d).app K = refinementIso (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) r K.obj e)
    : ∃ μ : Compositions (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) k,
      (∀ {X Y Z : Spaces k} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (c c' : Compactifications k f) (d d' : Compactifications k g)
    (e e' : Compactifications k (f ≫ g))
    (K : (localizing (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) X.obj.left).FullSubcategory),
      (image (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) d.obj).map ((φ f c c').hom.app K) ≫
          (φ g d d').hom.app
            ⟨(image (Profinite.padicIntegersRingObj ℓ E.val) c'.obj).obj K.obj, h.maps_localizing
              c' K.obj K.property⟩ ≫
          (μ f g c' d' e').hom.app K =
        (μ f g c d e).hom.app K ≫ (φ (f ≫ g) e e').hom.app K)
